zh.title: 英國航空公佈A380新客艙 設106個商務艙座位
zh.summary: 英國航空公佈A380新客艙；商務艙106座；號稱全球最大
body: 英國航空（British Airways）公佈其空中巴士A380的全新客艙設計。據Simple Flying報導，新客艙將設有106個商務艙座位。
報導以照片呈現這款新客艙，並稱其商務艙為「全球最大」（world’s largest）的商務客艙。
Simple Flying於2026年10月5日發布此消息。目前尚不清楚新客艙的實際推出時間或適用的航班路線。

en.title: British Airways unveils new Airbus A380 cabin with 106 business-class seats, world's largest layout
en.summary: British Airways unveils new A380 cabin; 106 business-class seats; touted world's largest
body: British Airways has unveiled an all-new cabin interior for its Airbus A380, according to Simple Flying, which showcased the design in photographs.
The new cabin layout will feature 106 business-class seats, a configuration the report describes as the world's largest business class cabin.
Simple Flying published the story on October 5, 2026. No timeline for the cabin entering service or the specific routes it will serve has been disclosed in the report.
